sources.label: 🧩 Android patches for Morphe: AMOLED themes, ad removal and premium unlocks for
sources.author: hxreborn
patch_list: Adds the Apps option to the chat file menu for sending installed apps as APK files.
Allows recording and posting stories while a call is active.
Replaces the dark theme background with pure black.
Blocks usage statistics sent to imo, AppsFlyer, Firebase and Facebook, and the advertising ID upload.
Removes the forced update screen and the update prompts.
Adds the burn-after-read option to voice messages in private and group chats.
Adds a results list to in-chat search.
Jumps to the first unread chat when the Chats tab is double-tapped.
Signs in through GmsCore instead of Google Play Services. Requires GmsCore to be installed.
Removes splash, chat list, story and end-of-call ads, and skips the ad consent form.
Hides the invite friends dialog, the invite entry in the chat list, the call sharing banner and the Invite to Official imo dialog for unregistered numbers.
Removes the Voice Club tab from the home screen.
Keeps the screen on while recording a voice message.
Stops chats and calls from reporting screenshots and screen recordings to the other person.
Raises the length limit on videos posted to a channel to 24 hours.
Raises the size limit on GIFs picked for custom stickers to 100 MB.
Raises the limit on photos, videos and files sent at once to 100 and the size of each photo and video to 3 GB.
Raises the limit on messages erased at once with Time Machine to 1000.
Allows copying, sharing, forwarding and downloading messages in chats with chat privacy or Time Machine turned on.
Raises the limit on contacts selected for iBubble close friends, Family Guard invites and group calls to 999. Experimental.
Allows forwarding disappearing and view-once text messages.
Removes the imo Premium entry from the Me page.
Allows screenshots and screen recording in chats, calls, media and profiles.
Removes the length limit on story videos picked from the gallery or recorded.
Sends text longer than 2000 characters as consecutive messages. Raises the chat input limit to 10000 characters. Privacy Chat messages are cut at 2000 characters.
Opens profile photos in full size when their owner restricts it.
Adds the Invisible Friends entry to the contacts list. Requires at least one invisible friend.
Restores phone verification by call when signing in.
